fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on press fairness and national politics; discussion of gambling and alleged organized-crime activity in Greater Miami; coverage of a newspaper labor dispute involving printers’ unions and publisher John S. Knight; an open letter to Gov. Warren urging action on public utilities and Florida Power & Light; items on taxation levels in Florida, public safety and emergency medical response delays, and regulation of poison sales following neighborhood dog poisonings. Additional local features address contractor licensing in Dade County, transportation incidents involving bus service, and racing-season logistics after Tropical Park.
